items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's back around James Allen. [INTERVIEWEE] That passed just two blocks, one block across James Allen.

ctx.x: That's one of the old Dixieland musicians back on, he lived back on Gravy Street between White and Gauza. No, White and Dupree. White and Dupree. He lived on Gravy Street between White and Dupree.

That passed just two blocks, one block across James Allen. That's where Rabbit used to hang out. That's right. I know Rabbit. That's right. I played with Rabbit a couple of times, but Rabbit played so bad I had to let him go.
